copy.whoLine: Sanghamitra does the work. Sreenivasa Ainapurapu founded it and still teaches, speaks, and hosts.
copy.homepageLede: Parents come for Vedic mathematics, SAT-facing math, and Telugu. Others come to donate or volunteer, to invite a talk on meditation, anger, or stress, or because they read his poetry. Everyone can write him from this site.

events.title: Summer Program 2026
events.blurb: Srinivasa Ramanujan Mathematricks Club — weekends from 6 June to 25 July. Vedic mathematics, problem-solving, and algorithms. The club has run this summer sitting since 2005. Medhavadhanam followed in August at the Hindu Temple of St. Louis.
